entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A kor planeswalker and member of the Gatewatch who enters Bontu's Trial of Ambition as an initiate and is horrified by the Trial.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: A young initiate of the Tah crop and Gideon's friend, who leads the crop through the Trial of Ambition and drowns Meris to claim his heart.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who brings Gideon to the Tah crop and guides him toward the Trials.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: The crocodile-headed god of ambition who sets the Trial of Ambition, demands a heart as toll from each initiate, and rebukes Gideon.

entities.name: Meris
entities.description: A young initiate of the Tah crop, wise beyond his years, who solved the final illusion of the Trial of Knowledge and is killed by Djeru.

entities.name: Imi
entities.description: An initiate of the Tah crop, Meris's partner, devoured by flesh-eating scarabs in the Trial.

entities.name: Hepthys
entities.description: An aven initiate of the Tah crop who uses wind magic and is killed by the ammit while covering Gideon.

entities.name: Dedi
entities.description: A tall, weaker initiate of the Tah crop who dissolves in acid filth in the first obstacle.

entities.name: Tausret
entities.description: A strong warrior of the Tah crop.

entities.name: Kamat
entities.description: A blunt naga woman of the Tah crop who fights Neit for her heart.

entities.name: Neit
entities.description: An initiate of the Tah crop who kills Kamat for her heart in the final room.

entities.name: Setha
entities.description: A jackal initiate of the Tah crop, twin of Basetha, killed by a trap blade.

entities.name: Basetha
entities.description: A jackal initiate of the Tah crop, twin of Setha, who crosses to Bontu with a heart.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A former member of the Tah crop and Djeru's closest friend who became a dissenter and was removed.

entities.name: Kesi
entities.description: A woman of the Tah crop who speaks of the restoration of the fallen.

entities.name: Masika
entities.description: An initiate of the Tah crop whom Djeru sends to a pillar in place of Tausret.

entities.name: Nassor
entities.description: A minotaur initiate who kills Tarik for his heart.

entities.name: Tarik
entities.description: An archer initiate killed by Nassor for his heart.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker who rules Amonkhet in absentia and whose return the initiates await.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who mistrusts Amonkhet.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch curious about Amonkhet.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who has a game named for him.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers that came to Amonkhet to uncover Nicol Bolas's machinations.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: A group of twenty initiates that Gideon joins to face the Trial of Ambition.

entities.name: Trial of Ambition
entities.description: Bontu's deadly Trial, a pyramid gauntlet that ends in a toll of one heart from each surviving initiate.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The city of Amonkhet where initiates train and the gods walk.

entities.name: Bontu's monument
entities.description: A massive pyramid bearing Bontu's form, within which the Trial of Ambition takes place.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A desert plane ruled in absentia by Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: The ammit
entities.description: A lion-bodied, alligator-headed demon near impossible to kill, which kills several initiates.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Gideon's earlier home plane that the celebration reminds him of.

entities.name: The anointed
entities.description: The mummified dead who serve the city; Gideon realizes they are initiates fallen in battle.

events.summary: Gideon follows Oketra through Naktamun and watches her warm, kind interactions with the people.
events.quote: There was no groveling, no fear from the masses before an almighty presence.

events.summary: Gideon, wearing a cartouche Oketra gave him, comes to a celebration square where initiates feast before the Trial of Ambition.
events.quote: I noticed all these initiates had cartouches with three segments.

events.summary: Oketra tells Gideon this is where the Trials begin, then leaves him with the initiate Djeru, who greets him as a friend.
events.quote: I am Djeru of the Tah crop.

events.summary: Djeru spars with Gideon and wins, then introduces him to the crop.
events.quote: You're good. You could be better. Come.

events.summary: Gideon learns that crops lose members through the Trials, and Djeru's crop is replacing one lost the day before.
events.quote: Many other crops are culled significantly from Trial to Trial, and reformed with others.

events.summary: Meris names the lost dissenter Samut, angering Djeru, who explains she chose heresy and was removed; Gideon recalls seeing a woman shouting that the gods lie.
events.quote: She is a dissenter ,

events.summary: Bontu stalks into the square and asks who deserves to compete in her Trial; Gideon boldly asks whether even the gods are born strong.
events.quote: Not even the gods?

events.summary: Bontu laughs at Gideon's brazenness and names him and the twenty members of the Tah crop as the next to face her Trial.
events.quote: You shall be next to face my Trial

events.summary: Viziers lead the crop into Bontu's monument and arm them for the Trial.
events.quote: Bontu has no patience for dawdling supplicants,

events.summary: Dedi wades into a filth pool to turn a crank that raises a bridge, but acid filth floods the chamber and dissolves him as the crop flees; one initiate is lost.
events.quote: skin and flesh sloughed off his forearm, revealing bone.

events.summary: Djeru and Tausret insist the crop press on, calling Dedi's death glorious, which disturbs Gideon.
events.quote: Dedi died a glorious death.

events.summary: An ammit attacks the crop in the second chamber and kills an initiate.
events.quote: with one powerful bite, the ammit had caught an initiate in its jaws.

events.summary: Gideon charges the ammit and finds his sural cannot cut it; his golden shield holds but cannot free him from its grip.
events.quote: Golden ripples of light danced across my body as I focused my magic

events.summary: Hepthys drives the ammit off Gideon with wind magic and is caught in the air and devoured.
events.quote: swallowing its prize in two snapping bites.

events.summary: Djeru rebukes Gideon for treating each glorious death as a tragedy and sends the crop through a corridor of bladed pendulums in order of speed.
events.quote: What is wrong with you?

events.summary: The ammit chases the last runners into the corridor and a blade kills Setha.
events.quote: a rogue blade reduced Setha to a black and red smear of viscera.

events.summary: Gideon uses his golden shield to smash through the swinging blades, disabling the trap, and Djeru grows suspicious of his abilities.
events.quote: The first one smashed into me, shattering and launching me into the wall

events.summary: Four initiates volunteer to stand on pillars to open the door while holding the ammit and monsters; Djeru swaps Masika for Tausret and the four are left behind.
events.quote: Masika. I need you to switch with Tausret.

events.summary: Gideon is rebuked for wanting to stay and the crop leaves the four to die.
events.quote: Where is your ambition?

events.summary: The nine survivors reach Bontu's summit chamber, having lost Imi to scarabs, and Bontu displays a scale at a bridge across serpent-filled water.
events.quote: We were now nine.

events.summary: Bontu announces her toll of one heart from each, saying the initiates' numbers are too great.
events.quote: Pay the toll, or fall short and perish.

events.summary: The initiates turn on each other for hearts: Neit kills an initiate, Kamat fights Neit, and Nassor kills Tarik.
events.quote: Neit was charging across toward the scales

events.summary: Meris and Djeru choose not to fight; Djeru embraces Meris and then drowns him in the serpent pool, cutting out his heart for the toll.
events.quote: Then he shoved him into the water.

events.summary: Bontu drains Gideon's strength with her gaze and commands him to watch while Djeru finishes the killing.
events.quote: Watch, Kytheon Iora. Quiet your judgment, and learn.

events.summary: Gideon furiously denounces the slaughter and dives across to confront Bontu, who calls him brazen and ignorant of her world.
events.quote: What mockery of faith and divinity is this madness?

events.summary: Bontu rebukes Gideon as shallow and selfish for judging instead of understanding, and tells him doubt is the shadow of faith.
events.quote: You look only for what satisfies your sense of justice.

events.summary: Bontu commands Gideon to leave her temple, and he exits and realizes the anointed are the remnants of fallen initiates.
events.quote: The anointed are the remnants of initiates fallen in battle.

events.summary: Gideon tears the cartouche from his neck, resolving to strike down Bolas.
events.quote: I tore the cartouche from my neck, dropping it on the ground before me.
